div.div:
أَسَافَةٌ [Grief, lamentation, or regret: and anger: (see 1:) or] excessive grief: and excessive anger: (M:) or most intense grief: (K:) a subst. from أَسِفَ. (M, K.) ―
-b2- The state, or condition, of a slave: (M, K:) and, of a hired man. (M.) ―
-b3- (tropical:) The state, or condition, of land which scarcely, or never, produces vegetation. (K, TA.) ＝
-A2- See أَسِيفٌ, in three places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
